subject.title: Memory MVP: build write pipeline with classification, dedupe, merge, and conflict handling

question: Should the Memory MVP write resolver be owned by memory-core as the active-memory contract, by Memory Wiki as a knowledge-layer workflow, or by a new plugin/SDK seam before implementation starts?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested behavior defines durable memory schema, conflict policy, provenance semantics, and operator UX; automation cannot safely choose that product boundary from code alone.

options.title: Sponsor a memory-core MVP design
options.body: Define the typed SQLite record model, source/provenance contract, resolver decisions, and review queue before implementation begins.

options.title: Defer to existing layers
options.body: Keep Markdown memory, dreaming promotion, and memory-wiki as the supported path for now and close or retarget this later if maintainers decide not to add a resolver.

options.title: Defer the MVP resolver
options.body: Keep current Markdown, promotion, and wiki layers while collecting more production examples before accepting durable schema or UX commitments.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a memory-core MVP design
recommendation.body: Define the typed SQLite record model, source/provenance contract, resolver decisions, and review queue before implementation begins.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across memory-core, memory docs, and plugin-boundary refactors among the sampled central files.
